## Area

Demo / workspace / API / evidence / handoff / account / billing / operations / evaluation

## Observed behavior

Describe the behavior without including patient information, source text, credentials or payment data.

## Expected behavior

Link the relevant V1 requirement or ticket when known.

## Reproduction

Use synthetic material and list the steps, expected result and actual result. For model execution, include only a redacted run ID and provider mode; do not paste a prompt or source document.

## Environment and evidence

Commit, browser or API version, request ID, screenshots with synthetic data, and relevant redacted logs.

## Acceptance check

State the regression that should pass after the change. Browser AI execution must be tested manually under the project rules.
